limits: Architectural bytes/line-crossing requests are not cache misses or physical external bus transactions.
Callback scopes exclude stock ISR, scheduling, DSP work and silicon stalls.
Paired callback cost sum and exclusive-symbol sum agree exactly for all 12800 calls in each profiler mode.
Pair metrics use only initial64frames; exclusive category metrics include all128frames and family changes.
Exactness relies on frozen source/canonical reference plus each retained transformation and full final raw-state proof.

production_working_sets.scope: Unions across initial64 dense-lock frames and both split callbacks per voice. Two voices independently synthesize. Full128-frame/all25600-call raw exactness, cycle, instruction, branch and request CSVs remain byte-identical to unobserved runs.
limits: Instruction bytes are executed address sets decoded by objdump, refusing any unknown executed PC. They are not instruction-fetch bytes or cache misses.
The 64-frame union includes changing controls/WT modes and is not an instantaneous live set. Cache-set occupancy alone cannot establish thrashing, replacement order or misses.
Synthetic native call stack placement differs from firmware private-IRQ stack; do not infer physical cache colors for stack data. Code, module state and table addresses come from actual linked image.
No modeled silicon I/D cache, external SDRAM, FlexBus/card/DMA arbitration or coherence latency. Architectural requested traffic is a separate measurement.
Cache geometry used only to label possible set overlap: 16KiB,4way,16B line,256sets, NXP MCF54455RM.

whole_CPU_margin_interpretation: Long ACK-to-ACK CPU work peaks at 362.466 us including intervening stock tasks: 0.346 us below frame period, 72.216 us over preferred 80% budget. This is not IRQ latency and establishes no 20% whole-CPU headroom or physical UI responsiveness.
